The last cutting of 2022: after it the 2022 panel never regrows to the 0.6-0.7 canopy that precedes every other cutting. NDVI stays at about 0.30-0.45 through September (the record has a gap in early to mid August), rises slowly to about 0.50 by mid October, and falls to about 0.35-0.40 in late October and again in late December; neither fall is from a regrown canopy, so no cutting is written (the late October fall could be a late cutting or the start of grazing). 2022 is also the only year of the run with a net source of annual NEE at the tower (+307.6 g C m-2, FLUXNET-1F, cal-val-data).
